caption: Deflection of the mid-surface gives the curvatures, and D turns them into moments. For the 3 mm aluminium plate of the example, D = 173.1 N·m.

spec.title: Thin plate bending
spec.aria: A downward block diagram: deflection w gives curvatures κ, curvatures multiplied by D give moments M, and the plate stiffness D sets their size.
